notes: אַף כִּי → *How much less* is one `noncompositional` unit headed on the first particle and on *less*.

Both *that*s are supplied relatives over verbless nominal predications the Hebrew juxtaposes to their subjects (rules 46, 55); the copulas and indefinite articles stay with רִמָּה and תּוֹלֵעָה under rules 20 and 15.
